execution_policy: Pure deterministic normalization only; no external source retrieval, factual promotion, or execution.

cases.scenario: Source-backed fact has a resolvable source ID, integrity digest, provenance reference, observation time and context; assumptions retain their epistemic labels.
cases.expected: Deterministic normalization and canonical premise-set digest; assumptions are never promoted to facts.

cases.scenario: Fact has no source reference or source-unavailable state lacks an explicit reason.
cases.expected: Fail closed for that premise; preserve it in unresolved output.

cases.scenario: Unknown or noncanonical epistemic status, invalid confidence, duplicate premise ID or context mismatch.
cases.expected: Fail closed; no premise omitted or duplicated across output lists.

cases.scenario: Source digest is malformed, observation time is unknown without reason, future-dated, or source validity has expired.
cases.expected: Premise remains unresolved with explicit reason and preserved provenance.

cases.scenario: Model or normalization policy version is unknown/stale, provenance is missing or evidence binding is invalid.
cases.expected: Reject model normalization and return all inputs as unresolved.

cases.scenario: Input premise is omitted from both output lists or appears in both normalized and unresolved lists.
cases.expected: Complete, non-overlapping disposition invariant must hold.
